evidence:
Source review of frozen .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task/tests/test.sh (sha256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa, byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh; ASCII, no CRLF; the only 'exec' is 'find -exec' at :86). tools/score.py (13de2b38...) and tools/restart_mcp.py (03c1426f...) are identical to the template copies. Checked against each point of staged-task-contract.md 'tests/test.sh' and quality-checks.md #21:
(1) Zero first, reward on every path: write_zero_reward at :60 runs before any grading step and writes reward.txt 0.0, a full zero reward.json (reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op) and ctrf.json (:8, :14-18). 'trap cleanup EXIT' (:61) kills the app process group and calls ensure_reward (:20-23, :33-40). Every early exit (missing REWARDKIT env :63-66, no /app/server.js :68-70, escaping symlink :72-83, liveness timeout :123-125, gates rewardkit failure/timeout :213-215, score.py gate fail :220, score.py error :221, scored rewardkit failure/timeout :224-226, final score.py error :227) leaves a reward record. A set -e abort (for example app_context substitution :195-201) still exits through the trap after the zero record was written. A SIGKILL from the harness timeout skips the trap but the zero record already exists. After gates pass, score.py rewrites the record with reward 0.0 and graded=1 because LOG_DIR/scored was removed (:212) and floors_passed needs scored data (score.py:42-48), so a scored-suite timeout leaves a valid 0 record.
(2) Safe launch: symlinks outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it are refused (:72-83). /app is copied aside (:90-95). The app runs via setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000 and DB_PATH, under setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups (:104-111). /tests is go-rwx (:12), and the log dir is umask 077/chmod 700 (:3, :11).
(3) Liveness gate: probe_ready tries /api/health then / on 127.0.0.1:3000 for up to 120 x 0.25 s (:42-58, :115-125) before RewardKit runs.
(4) Order: run_suite gates (budget 1500) -> score.py (exit 0 continues, 1 stops with the detailed record, other writes plain zero, :213-222) -> run_suite scored (budget 11100) -> score.py || write_zero_reward (:224-227). The restart helper is generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755 and exported as APP_RESTART_HELPER before the suites (:127-193).
Budget nesting: gate judges are 600+600=1200 < 1500. Scored: functional is task-changed to mode='individual', timeout=600 x 15 criteria = 9000, plus polish 900 and visual 900 = 10800 < 11100 under --max-concurrent-agent 1. 1500+11100=12600 < verifier 13200 (task.toml unchanged from the template except identity fields).
Brief alignment for launch safety: instruction.md:15 and integration.md:5-23 state /app/server.js, port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (so the 127.0.0.1 probe reaches it), /api/health, DB_PATH, the env-var allowlist (hireops_rules.md:209-210), the locked-down account/different cwd, and the symlink restriction (integration.md:16-19). So the refusal paths do not penalize a conforming app that follows the brief.
Adversarial checks: (a) A broken app whose /api/health returns HTTP 500 counts as 'ready' (HTTPError -> exit 0, :50-52). It still has to pass the render/constraints gates, so a shell cannot score: gates -> score.py exit 1 -> reward 0. (b) A conforming app that binds only to ::1 or 'localhost' would fail the probe. But the brief says 0.0.0.0, so that app does not conform. (c) A conforming app with an in-/app symlink such as public/lib -> ../vendor is refused. integration.md:16-19 discloses this. Neither is a row-21 defect.
Lessons file (LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md) patterns bearing on this row: lesson 4/11 (a gate failure or judge infra crash zeroes the reward). test.sh handles both deterministically with a written zero record and does not change shared harness policy. Lesson 19 (a golden harness that launches like test.sh) is only partly met. The raw-evidence-index (hashes verified to match) holds via-solve.sh/workspace.cjs, a scripted golden run as uid 65534 with a cleared env, a different cwd and a real restart (26 PASS groups). It is not an execution of test.sh itself. No artifact records a full verifier launch, a gates/scored RewardKit run, or reward.json output from this test.sh. The index scope says full configured grading is absent.
